Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS; [29, 30]) evaluates a positive body image-related construct—body appreciation defined as a posture of acceptance and protection toward one's own body's features, despite the assumption of a certain degree of body dissatisfaction.

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: BMI was calculated by dividing participants' reported body weight by the square of their self-reported height (kg/m2 ).

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section states that BMI was calculated from participants' self-reported weight and height and lists the instruments used: EMWSS_Peers (early peer warmth/safeness), the Self-Compassion Scale (positive subscales only), the Social Safeness and Pleasure Scale (SSPS), the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS/BAS-2), and the EDE-Q (global score). The section provides psychometric notes for each instrument but does not report sample size, demographics, survey method, or any correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
